text.description_html:
Deltana DEL-DHK-RUBBER Door Kickdown Rubber Tip

This is a replacement rubber tip for the Deltana Door Kickdown door stops. Fits
DHK4 4-inch Kickdown Door Holder, DHK5 5-inch Kickdown Door Holder and DHK7 7-inch Kickdown Door Holder.

They are held in place with the centered screw. Easy to replace - Just remove the screw and pull the old rubber tip out of the kickdown. Slide the replacement tip in and re-install the attachment screw.

Note: The Kickdown door holder does NOT have to be removed from the door to replace the tip.

Warning: These work for Kickdown Door Holders manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your Kickdown's were manufactured by Deltana, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
